q: 医生开的药我已经吃___了，咳嗽也好多了。
en: I've already finished the medicine the doctor prescribed, and my cough is much better.

q: 天气预报说明天下雪，我们的厚衣服都准备___了。
en: The forecast says it will snow tomorrow, and our warm clothes are all ready.

q: 我终于学___游泳了，夏天可以自己去海边玩了。
en: I've finally learned to swim, so this summer I can go to the beach by myself.

q: 医生让你吃___饭再吃这种药。
en: The doctor says to take this medicine after you've finished eating.

q: 医生说他腿上的伤还没长___，所以暂时不能去滑冰。
en: The doctor says the wound on his leg hasn't healed properly yet, so he can't go skating for now.

q: 夏天太热了，我跑了三家店才买___风扇。
en: It was so hot that summer I went to three shops before I managed to buy a fan.

q: 我找了半天，终于在包里找___体温计了。
en: I searched for ages and finally found the thermometer in my bag.

q: 医生用了很多英文词，我一个也没听___。
en: The doctor used lots of English words and I didn't understand a single one.

q: 你昨天寄的体检报告，我今天上午已经收___了。
en: I already received the medical report you sent yesterday this morning.

q: 他说得太快，虽然每个字我都听见了，但整句话没听___。
en: He spoke so fast that although I heard every word, I didn't understand the whole sentence.

q: 天气预报是中文的，我看了三遍还是没看___。
en: The weather forecast was in Chinese; I read it three times and still didn't understand it.

q: 护士把我的名字写___了，应该是李，不是力。
en: The nurse wrote my name wrongly; it should be 李, not 力.

q: 旁边太吵了，医生的话我一个字也没听___，请他再说一遍。
en: It was so noisy next to me that I could not hear a word the doctor said clearly, so I asked him to say it again.

q: 雪天路很脏，我把鞋擦___再进屋。
en: The road was dirty in the snow, so I wiped my shoes clean before going in.

q: 你把吃药的次数记___了，应该是一天两次，不是三次。
en: You got the number of doses wrong; it should be twice a day, not three times.

q: 他把体检表上的数字抄___了一个，结果医生也算错了。
en: He copied one of the numbers on the medical form wrongly, so the doctor's calculation came out wrong too.

q: 这个电话号码很重要，请你一定要记___。
en: This phone number is important, so please be sure to remember it.

q: 昨天太热了，我一晚上都没睡___。
en: It was so hot yesterday that I couldn't fall asleep all night.

q: 夏天太热了，请把窗户打___。
en: It's so hot in summer, please open the window.

q: 感冒好了，这些没吃完的药可以扔___了。
en: Your cold is better, so you can throw away the medicine you didn't finish.

q: 有人把我放在门口的雨伞拿___了。
en: Somebody took away the umbrella I left by the door.

q: 夏天我们太爱喝冰水了，一大壶冰水一下子就喝___了。
en: We love iced water so much in summer that the whole jug was gone in no time.

q: 他一路上都在咳嗽，同事让他吃片药压___，免得开会时影响大家。
en: He coughed all the way, so his colleagues told him to take a pill to suppress it so that he wouldn't disturb everyone in the meeting.

q: 跑步的时候他突然头晕，赶紧扶___旁边的树。
en: While running he suddenly felt dizzy and quickly grabbed hold of the tree beside him.

q: 春天来了，天气暖和了，大家都把厚衣服脱___了。
en: Spring has come and it's warm, so everybody has taken off their heavy clothes.

q: 太阳出来了，雾慢慢散___了。
en: The sun came out and the fog slowly cleared.

q: 我把雨伞放___门后面了。
en: I put the umbrella behind the door.

q: 妈妈把感冒药递___我，让我快点吃。
en: Mum handed me the cold medicine and told me to take it quickly.

q: 医生把这张药方写___了中文，我才看得懂。
en: The doctor wrote the prescription in Chinese, so I could read it.

q: 冬天的雪很厚，孩子们把雪堆___了一座小山。
en: The winter snow was thick, and the children piled it up into a small hill.

q: 请你把今天的天气预报转告___每一位同学，明天可能有大雨。
en: Please pass today's weather forecast on to every student; there may be heavy rain tomorrow.

q: 他把每次的检查结果都登记___一个小本子上，方便下次看病。
en: He records every set of test results in a little notebook so it is handy for his next doctor visit.

q: 夏天太热，爸爸把西瓜切___八块，大家一起吃。
en: It was so hot in summer that Dad cut the watermelon into eight pieces for everyone to share.

q: 医生让他把这些药分___三次吃。
en: The doctor told him to split this medicine into three doses.

q: 昨天雾太大了，我们都___看见山。
en: It was so foggy yesterday that none of us saw the mountain.

q: 今天的天气预报我___看完，不知道明天下不下雨。
en: I haven't finished the weather forecast yet, so I don't know whether it will rain tomorrow.

q: 他昨天___听清楚医生的话，所以今天又去了一次医院。
en: He didn't hear the doctor clearly yesterday, so he went to the hospital again today.

q: 对不起，我___找到你的体检报告，明天再给你好吗？
en: Sorry, I didn't find your medical report; may I give it to you tomorrow?

q: 虽然已经吃了三天药，但是他的药还___吃完，医生让他继续吃。
en: Although he has taken the medicine for three days, he hasn't finished the course yet, and the doctor told him to keep taking it.

q: 夏天的雨太大，我的伞___撑住，被风吹走了。
en: The summer rain was so heavy that my umbrella couldn't hold up and was blown away by the wind.

q: 我洗___澡就去睡觉了。
en: I went to bed as soon as I'd had my shower.

q: 下___课，我们一起去医院看小王吧。
en: Let's go to the hospital to visit Xiao Wang together after class finishes.

q: 我刚才在抽屉里找到___两个体温计。
en: I just found two thermometers in the drawer.

q: 我吃完___两片药，才觉得舒服一点。
en: I only felt a bit better after I'd taken the two tablets.

q: 天气太热，他一口气喝完___整整一瓶冰水，结果肚子疼了。
en: It was so hot that he drank a whole bottle of iced water in one go, and then his stomach hurt.

q: 风太大，晾在外面的衣服都被吹走___。
en: The wind was so strong that the clothes hanging outside were all blown away.

q: 你的感冒药吃完___没有？
en: Have you finished your cold medicine?

q: —你看完今天的天气预报了吗？—看完___。
en: —Have you finished reading today's weather forecast? —Yes, I've finished.

q: —你把药吃完了吗？—___吃完，我晚上再吃。
en: —Have you finished the medicine? —Not yet, I'll take it again this evening.
